title: The Broué invariant of a Morita equivalence with an endopermutation source
summary: A perfect isometry $I$ (introduced by Broué) between two blocks $b$ and $c$ is a frequent phenomenon in the block theory of finite groups. It maps an irreducible character $ψ$ of $c$ to $\pm$ an irreducible character of $b$. Broué proved that the ratio of the codegrees of $ψ$ and $I(ψ)$ is a rational number with $p$-value zero and that its class in $\mathbb{F}_p$ is independent of $ψ$. This element is called the Broué invariant of $I$ by Boltje.
